svg.title: Exponential growth on linear and logarithmic scales
svg.desc: The same positive function Y/Y0=2 to the t and the same five marked values appear on two panels. It curves upward on a linear vertical scale. It is a straight line on a logarithmic vertical scale with equally spaced labels 1,2,4,8,16. The horizontal time scale is linear in both panels.
